description:
I’m Swayam, an Engineering Admission and Career Counsellor who supports students in making well-informed decisions after 12th.
I assist with college and branch selection across Maharashtra, keeping student aptitude and realistic opportunities in mind.
My guidance includes CAP round understanding, cutoff trend analysis, and accurate option filling to avoid last-minute confusion.
I focus on explaining the process in a simple, transparent way so students feel confident at every step.
My aim is to provide calm, honest support during one of the most important phases of a student’s journey.
